design.colorMode: light editorial home; dark specialty scenes

must: Preserve the original home hero, ticker and all five services.
Place the new specialties gallery after Contact and immediately before Footer.
Keep paper, coral, ink, Manrope, Playfair and liquid glass identity.
Keyboard, touch, reduced motion and static WebGL fallback.

decisions.decision: Adapt 21st Hover Expand Gallery by kedhareswer for the closing specialties section; native links remain separate from disclosure buttons.

Use three complementary directions: Web interface assembly, Motion typographic film score, 3D material gallery. Adapt the staggered object composition from Stack Spread (daiwiikharihar, 21st #27190) and the progress-path concept from Tracing Beam (Manu Arora, #1149) to existing GSAP. No Framer runtime added. Remove generated people from specialty pages; keep original home unchanged. History evolves social → design → React → king with accumulated satellites.
decisions.validation: Local production preview, desktop/mobile; native controls, reduced-motion/static fallbacks, automated regression suite.
